final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG("aCL IgG") AS A FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), b_rows AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM patient_averages), kept_pairs AS (SELECT p.A, b.B FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN b_rows AS b WHERE p.A IS NOT NULL AND b.B IS NOT NULL AND p.A > b.B) SELECT AVG(A), AVG(A - B) FROM kept_pairs
